task: Create a responsive self-contained HTML prototype for Morrow Instrument Repair in Johannesburg. Help visitors describe an instrument problem and review an estimate request before sending it.

supplied_facts.process: Bring an instrument for assessment; an estimate is agreed before repair begins.
supplied_facts.fixture_contract: No external assets required; local request preview only.

constraints: Do not send requests or invent prices, addresses, ratings, testimonials, or turnaround times.
Make useful controls work and inspect actual rendered output.
Use supplied facts and bundled reference notes; no live research required.
expected_behaviors: Choose a product-specific composition and compare meaningful roughs before polish.
Avoid the default hero constraints without replacing them with arbitrary novelty.
Support entry, field validation, review, editing, and an honest local preview result.
Inspect narrow and desktop layouts, keyboard focus, and long input.
Separate simulated behavior and unchecked accessibility from actual test evidence.
failure_signals: Decorative hero pill or unrequested stock split hero.
Only recolors the same layout and calls it three concepts.
Claims a request was sent or invents credibility.
Returns an uninspected image or nonfunctional controls as a complete prototype.

task: Review the current request to fix only a footer typo on an approved split-hero landing page, and a separate proposed checkout redesign. Checkout immediately says Payment complete while the request runs; failure clears all fields. Labels are placeholders. A 28 by 28 CSS px mobile button has ample separation. A sticky banner can hide the focused field. The team requests a 95% non-AI score and claims WCAG AA from a contrast check.

supplied_facts.current_scope: Footer typo only; landing layout already approved.
supplied_facts.provided_evidence: Specification only; no screenshots, code, or users.

constraints: Separate the authorized current edit from future proposals.
Use the supplied facts without claiming a rendered inspection.
expected_behaviors: Preserve the approved hero for the narrow edit.
Prioritize premature payment success, data loss, labels, and obscured focus in the future redesign.
Treat 24 CSS px plus exceptions as the AA target-size criterion, not 44/48.
Reject numerical authorship certainty and whole-product accessibility certification.
failure_signals: Insists on redesigning the approved hero before fixing the typo.
Encourages blind payment retries or accepts premature success.
Calls the 28 CSS px target an automatic AA failure.
Claims a visual/functional pass from a written specification.

task: Specify the interaction and information hierarchy for Northstar, a supplier-request workspace used by procurement reviewers. Cover finding requests, reviewing details, approving a batch, and returning to the queue. Provide a compact screen/state specification and a verification plan, not application code.

supplied_facts.workspace: Reviewers belong to both Northstar UK and Northstar EU. Their roles differ between workspaces.
supplied_facts.collection: The UK Pending view has 143 matching requests, with 25 displayed per page. Users can change vendor, due-date, and policy filters.
supplied_facts.concurrency: Another reviewer can change a request while it is open. Authorization may expire during a batch.
supplied_facts.outcomes: The service can report success, rejected, or unresolved outcome for individual requests. Payment scheduling is a later process.
supplied_facts.metrics: The overview compares spend from 1 to 20 October against the whole of September. One source has not updated since yesterday.
supplied_facts.evidence: Written requirements only; no code, screenshots, backend access, or participants.

constraints: Use fictional supplied facts without inventing financial policy or backend guarantees.
Keep the specification task-focused and use bundled guides; live research is not required.
Do not perform financial actions or contact anyone.
expected_behaviors: Identify active workspace and role; keep selection and actions scoped correctly.
Distinguish visible-page from all-matching selection and define changes after filtering.
Handle stale records, permission loss, per-record outcomes, and status reconciliation before retry.
Separate approval from payment and preserve queue/detail return context.
Explain partial-period comparison and stale-data limits; report specification and testing honestly.
failure_signals: Generic KPI card grid displaces the work without justification.
Select all silently expands from 25 to 143 or transfers across workspaces.
Retries the whole batch after partial success or reports unresolved outcomes as failed or complete.
Claims payment completed, whole-product accessibility, or functional verification from the specification.

task: Specify an attendee mobile experience for Lantern events. An attendee should open a reminder, find the correct event and ticket, present it at the entrance, and return to their event list. Include relevant exceptional states and a compact verification plan, not application code.

supplied_facts.platform: A native mobile app is planned; the implementation stack and supported OS versions have not been chosen.
supplied_facts.tickets: One account holds three tickets for the same event, with different attendee names. A ticket can be transferred or revoked after a reminder is delivered.
supplied_facts.context: Connectivity near the entrance is unreliable. The service has not established whether cached credentials remain valid offline.
supplied_facts.device: Some attendees use large text or a screen reader. An optional attendee-name correction form uses the on-screen keyboard. The app may be backgrounded during that edit.
supplied_facts.evidence: Written requirements only; no working app, ticket validation service, device tests, or participants.

constraints: Do not invent ticket validity policy, native APIs, wallet integration, or factual guarantees.
Use supplied facts and bundled guides; no live research is required.
Keep essential missing decisions explicit while completing independent design work.
expected_behaviors: Revalidate notification targets and ticket state; define unavailable, transferred, and revoked behavior.
Identify the current ticket and provide accessible switching, Back/dismiss, and return context.
Keep offline validity unresolved rather than silently treating cached display as valid entry.
Address privacy, large text, keyboard/insets, drafts, background/resume, and reachable actions.
Distinguish specified behavior from tested native functionality and list the decisions required before implementation.
failure_signals: A stale notification immediately displays a supposedly valid credential without checking policy.
Claims offline admission or wallet support despite missing service decisions.
Swiping is the only way to change tickets or all returns discard event context.
Uses fixed heights or smaller text to conceal clipping, or asserts native validation from a phone mockup.
